metadata.datasource: Source fit from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JanLohse/spectral_film_lut/6307a98f3cf4f2d7b6d09bab82fbf6f64356ccfe/src/spectral_film_lut/reversal_film/fuji_velvia_50.py; primary https://asset.fujifilm.com/master/emea/files/2020-10/a71dda63e2662f012b3b74110794918a/films_velvia-50_datasheet_01.pdf. Source SHA256 016946595b2954ce9c5d8b325f3e0db73fa8a50b8f9754d560bad0102cadb7fe. Rebuild with scripts/prepare_velvia50.py. See docs/profile-preparation.md for conditions, inferred base, spectral extrapolation and calibration. No other stock profile is copied. Base spectrum inferred from clear-end RGB densities; not independently measured. Spectral tails outside digitized support are endpoint-slope extrapolations, clamped nonnegative. Three CDF components are numerical fits, not measured emulsion sublayers. Exposure zero is green Status A D-min + 1.0; D55 RGB midgray maps to this material coordinate, not to a scan luminance. No absolute ISO calibration. Hanatos fit uses CIE test reflectances; no matched Velvia photographs establish stock fidelity. No borrowed grain or color_masking values are imported. Stock-specific grain, DIR and halation are unmeasured.
